scientific_scope_status: For arbitrary P, replace true rank by a supplied model budget r. At each cut choose probability-valued rows s_h of span<=r on actual P-positive prefixes, without cross-cut consistency; w_r(P) is the attained minimum over these families of max cutwise expected L1 error. The accepted same sample-only selection algorithm gives TV(P,H)<=epsilon+256 A0^2[D(P||Q)+w_r(P)]^(1/131072). Neither error, a shadow model nor its evaluator/sampler is supplied.
